summary: Spain (ES) was added to the EU country config with standard/reduced rates and reverse-charge text, and VAT category rate computation now explicitly handles ES. However, due to truncation and lack of diffs for the broader flow/results files, it’s not fully evidenced that ES no longer shows “Configuration Pending”/enables “Start Calculator”, nor that selected reduced rates are carried through consistently into calculation results.

missing_requirements.requirement: Spain no longer shows "Configuration Pending" messaging in the VAT country details/transaction steps and the "Start Calculator" action is enabled for ES.
missing_requirements.reason: While ES is marked configured=true in the country config, the diff summary does not show any UI logic or gating logic changes that remove "Configuration Pending" messaging or enable the CTA based on ES readiness. The only UI diff shown is CountryTransactionStep.tsx and it is truncated before any such messaging/CTA logic could be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Spain-specific VAT category-to-rate mapping returns Spain-appropriate reduced rates for relevant categories and standard rate for non-eligible categories.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows ES is routed to computeSpainRate(...), but the actual implementation of computeSpainRate is not visible in the provided truncated excerpt, so the specific Spain category mapping and rates cannot be verified from the diff summary alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: When ES is selected and the user chooses reduced VAT treatment, the UI offers Spain’s reduced rate options and uses the chosen rate as effectiveVatRate for calculations; results reflect the selected reduced rate.
missing_requirements.reason: CountryTransactionStep.tsx introduces reducedRates reading from the country config and auto-select logic, but the key logic that sets/exports an effectiveVatRate and ensures downstream calculation/results use selectedReducedRate is truncated. Also, no concrete diff is shown for the calculator orchestration/results components to confirm the effective rate is used end-to-end.
